subject: CAIQ: conditional evidence approach & ingestion plan
messages:
From: SableTech Security <security@sabletech.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ – follow-up: conditional evidence for EU residency

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Attached is the CAIQ extract we would like Redwood to complete. A few control items will require live evidence (runtime traces, sampling of audit logs) but due to our internal policy we need to scope those to EU-only tenant traffic.

Key asks:
- Mark any answers that are "conditional" (i.e., evidence only for EU tenant scope).
- Provide a short ingestion plan for how runtime logs will be transferred (SFTP/secure Drive/DocuSign access).
- Indicate owner(s) for each control and an estimated delivery date.

Ideally we get a first-pass back within 5 business days so our internal review can proceed.

Regards,
Anita Rao
Senior InfoSec Manager | SableTech
security@sabletech.com

Attachments: sabletech-conditional-questions.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, SableTech Security <security@sabletech.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ – follow-up: conditional evidence for EU residency

Thanks Anita — looping in Marissa and Jonas to own the CAIQ mapping and the evidence path. High level proposal below; please weigh in.

Proposal (first pass):
1) Split the questionnaire into: a) assertions (static docs, configuration screenshots, process narratives) b) conditional runtime proofs (sample logs, replayer traces)
2) We’ll flag cells in the CAIQ spreadsheet as: ANSWER / CONDITIONAL / OUT_OF_SCOPE. Conditional items will contain a one-line evidence policy (e.g., "EU tenant runtime logs: sampling window 2026-07-15 to 2026-07-22; redacted PII; transferred via secure Drive link with restricted access").
3) Owner assignments: Marissa will coordinate static artifacts and DocuSign access; Jonas will own runtime sampling and the transfer method; I will shepherd sign-offs and timeline. PrIyom — please verify any KMS/key-rotation artifacts we reference are available for EU residency.

Timeline: preliminary answers + spreadsheet back to SableTech by 2026-08-27; conditional runtime sample to follow (target 2026-09-02) pending legal/transfer approval.

Attachments: redwood-caiq-prelim-answers.xlsx (draft with flagged conditional cells)

Thanks —
Lauren
Head of Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, SableTech Security <security@sabletech.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ – conditional evidence approach & ingestion plan

+1 on timeline. I’ve started annotating the spreadsheet with which artifacts we can provide immediately (design docs, config screenshots, role matrices). I attached a trimmed draft (redwood-caiq-prelim-answers.xlsx) and added an owner column.

Notes on conditional runtime evidence:
- Runtime logs: we can produce a 24‑hour sample window filtered by EU tenant IDs and redact IPs and user identifiers. That will live on a restricted Drive folder (link below).
- Transfer: propose secure Drive (restricted to SableTech SSO) for the initial handoff; if they require a pull-based method we can set up a time-limited SFTP user.
- Legal: we’ll need DPA confirmation for the transfer and a statement of scope; I’ll start the DocuSign envelope and add Anita as signer.

Drive link (access controlled): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSableTech-CAIQ

Attachment: redwood-caiq-prelim-answers.xlsx

Marissa
Senior Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: CAIQ – conditional evidence approach & ingestion plan

Thanks — quick operational clarifications from my side:

1) Sampling details: we will extract a 24‑hour runtime trace for the EU tenant IDs specified by SableTech. The extract will strip raw request/response bodies and retain headers, timestamps, and op-codes needed for control proofs. I will attach a sanitized runtime-log-sample.txt to the Drive folder for their review before full transfer.

2) Proof of custody: for any runtime upload we will provide a signed manifest (SHA256 checksums) and a short chain-of-custody note. If SableTech wants DocuSign attestation for receipt, we can route the transfer via the envelope link Marissa creates.

3) KMS artifacts: PrIyom — please confirm that key rotation screenshots and the EU-only key policy doc are in the artifact bucket; if not, flag now.

I’ll start the extraction job once legal confirms DPA scope.

—Jonas
Platform Security Lead | Redwood Inference
